name: Datadog
description: Monitor Datadog observability configuration including active monitors, synthetic tests, and alerting setup for compliance evidence

config.setupInstructions:
You will need both an API Key and an Application Key from Datadog.

Step 1 — Create an API Key
1. In Datadog, go to Organization Settings > API Keys
2. Click New Key, name it (e.g. "Comp AI"), and copy the key

Step 2 — Create an Application Key with the required scopes
1. Go to Organization Settings > Application Keys
2. Click New Key, name it (e.g. "Comp AI App Key")
3. Add ALL four scopes — each is needed for a specific check:
   - monitors_read       (Monitoring & Alerting check)
   - synthetics_read     (Synthetic Tests check)
   - audit_logs_read     (Audit Logging check)
   - user_access_read    (User Management check)
4. Click Save and copy the key

Important: Application Keys inherit the creator's role permissions. The user creating the key must have the equivalent read access for each scope, or the key will be created without that scope (causing 403 "Failed permission authorization checks" errors when running the check).

Step 3 — Enter both keys + your Datadog site below
Datadog Site options:
   - datadoghq.com      (US1, default)
   - us3.datadoghq.com  (US3)
   - us5.datadoghq.com  (US5)
   - datadoghq.eu       (EU1, Germany)
   - ap1.datadoghq.com  (AP1, Japan)
   - ap2.datadoghq.com  (AP2, Australia)
   - ddog-gov.com       (US1-FED, US Government)
   - us2.ddog-gov.com   (US2-FED, US Government)

Optional: For the Monitoring & Alerting check, you can set a "Monitor tag filter" (e.g. env:prod) in the check settings to scope only relevant monitors. Leave empty to check all monitors.
